name: tooltip-card
title: Tooltip Card
description: Attaches a tooltip to any element. Hovering or tapping shows a small dark panel with a title and text near the pointer; it springs open, flips at screen edges and closes on leave.
use: A short hint, definition or preview should appear right at the pointer without shifting the page.
avoid: The panel opens from pointer events only, so keyboard and screen-reader users never reach it.
a11y: The trigger has no focus or keyboard handlers and the panel is not tied to it with aria-describedby, so assistive tech misses it. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two small outlined buttons, "Hover me" and "Or hover me", sit on a near-black stage under a line of grey caption text. A hover reveals a dark rounded panel with a bold heading and a few lines of grey text floating next to the cursor, or a single short line in the string variant.
behaves: Entering a button springs the panel open from zero height close to the pointer, and it follows the cursor while open. Near a viewport edge it jumps to the other side, and it collapses when the pointer leaves or after a touch tap.
customise: The panel body is a content prop, string or markup, and the trigger is passed as children; width, colours and padding live in the source.
weight: light: A single panel mounts on hover; no animation loop and no canvas.
